# Current: (8,44), facing up (hash 7b4543609e571c0e)

for i in range(40):
    result = action(['LEFT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    char_node = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 135]
    container_pixels = sum(n['pixels'] for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N')
    if char_node:
        char_pos = f"({min(p[0] for p in char_node[0]['boundary'])},{min(p[1] for p in char_node[0]['boundary'])})"
    else:
        char_pos = "?"
    if result.get('no_impact'):
        print(f"LEFT {i+1}: blocked at {char_pos}, container={container_pixels}")
        break
    print(f"LEFT {i+1}: char at {char_pos}, container={container_pixels}")
    if result.get('level_completed') or result.get('done'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETED!")
        break
</parameter>
